scope: target-object development J/F; known crop baseline, not innovation or paper gate
metric_scale: [0,1]; deltas times100 are absolute percentage points
target_policy: same native initial target ID; no union

train.weighting: 24 horizon events per parent, duplicates retained, four equal parents
train.endpoint_policy: all fixed horizon events including4 final-frame events

dev.endpoint_policy: exclude first/last from means; retain all raw metrics
dev.weighting: equal two parents; equal interior frames within parent

cost_note: Native cache and added refinement costs separate; no common-budget speed claim.
